comparison.objective: Light a Bunsen burner using a gas tap and spark striker, then return the striker; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed bimanual valve operation and striker positioning/squeezing versus coaxial rotary tools and counter-torque.
comparison.success_condition: Requires ignition without exceeding unlit-gas time, a burning end state, returned striker, and clearance; candidate requires precise retained angle and repeated cold actuation.
comparison.reason: Simultaneous two-hand operation is only a generic primitive; the mechanisms, hazards, and observable outcomes differ materially.
